func BackpressureActions(a [][3]int)([]string,bool){o:=[]string{};for _,x:=range a{if x[0]<0||x[0]>10000000||x[1]<0||x[1]>10000000||(x[2]!=0&&x[2]!=1){return nil,false};v:="IDLE";if x[0]>x[1]{v="DROP"}else if x[0]>0&&x[2]==1{v="SEND"}else if x[0]>0{v="PAUSE"};o=append(o,v)};return o,true}
